create_ClassyTask_subclass: create a subclass of ClassyTask that implements all abstract methods for a custom training task
build_from_config: build a ClassyTask instance from a configuration dictionary using the from_config class method
run_train_step: run a single training step over one batch of data from the dataloaders
checkpoint_get_set_state: get and set the ClassyTask state dictionary for saving and loading training checkpoints
run_hooks: run hook functions for all registered ClassyHook instances with local variables from train_step
